# registry_scanning_stats (Data Source)

Reads aggregate security scan statistics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_scanning_stats" "current" {}

output "critical_findings" {
  value = data.registry_scanning_stats.current.critical_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `critical_count` (Number) Critical severity findings.
- `failed_scans` (Number) Number of scans that failed.
- `high_count` (Number) High severity findings.
- `low_count` (Number) Low severity findings.
- `medium_count` (Number) Medium severity findings.
- `passed_scans` (Number) Number of scans that passed.
- `pending_scans` (Number) Number of scans pending or running.
- `total_findings` (Number) Total findings across all scans.
- `total_scans` (Number) Total number of scans.
